name: Family Fridge
short: A phone web app where a family logs meals by photo or voice. AI estimates the calories and everyone sees it on a shared fridge.
role: Product and visual design; I direct an AI agent team that builds it
stack: Expo (React Native + web), Supabase, Edge Functions, Web Push, OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini, Vercel

images.alt: Family Fridge onboarding screens: sign in, about you, your family, new kid (sample data)

highlights: Log a meal by photo or voice; AI estimates calories, and you can always edit them
Table: one family question a day; you see others' answers after you answer
Trades: log a trade from a screenshot; a chosen reviewer verifies it
Kids need no account and get no calorie targets, following pediatric guidance
next: Native iPhone and Android builds from the same codebase
Friends beta with a few families

timeline.title: Trades: a second log type with review
timeline.body: Log a trade from a screenshot; AI reads the pair and direction. A reviewer verifies one trade or a whole day.

timeline.title: Table: a daily family question
timeline.body: Questions built from local events, news and weather. Answers unlock once you've answered yourself.

timeline.title: v1 web app: logging, fridge, trends, push
timeline.body: Photo, voice or text logging with AI estimates, the Family Board, cheers, trends and web push. Installs to the Home Screen.

timeline.title: React Native with the web app first
timeline.body: Dropped the iOS-only plan for one Expo codebase across web, iPhone and Android. The web app ships first.

timeline.title: Visual direction: Gallery Wall
timeline.body: Picked from six directions after asking for something more polished.

timeline.title: Product shape agreed
timeline.body: A Family Board home, one-tap photo/voice capture, and an activity feed.

timeline.title: Requirements
timeline.body: Family accounts and kid profiles without logins or calorie targets.
